rule.replicate_unit: runs: one 16-room x 300 s batch per job, six per arm, seed-matched (brain seed k, env seeds 16k..16k+15)
rule.primary: total take-offs (hops = escape + voluntary) per run at equal exposure (4,800 fly-s): a two-sample exact Poisson (conditional binomial on the pooled counts, scipy.stats.binomtest(K_inst, K_inst + K_raw, 0.5)), ONE-SIDED, direction stated once: the instrumented list is `worse` iff its take-off rate is HIGHER (H1: instrumented > raw); fail at p < 0.05 (INTERP 10.4 rule 17); the run-level common.compare (6 v 6) is quoted beside it
rule.descriptive: escape and voluntary take-offs separately (the same tests, no verdict), meals, path, walking-GF median
rule.validity: 12 runs; the wrapper's `room` block with no problems (raw: preset raw, no records, shipped cache; instrumented: the three records, the hold in type_path_gain, GLNO glutamate, the relabel cache); device cuda; 16 rows x 30,000 frames; every loaded source at the predeclared hash
rule.adoption: none either way: a pass records that the list is admissible under PRESETS_SPEC section 2 item 5 (suite half + room rate-half), nothing more
